definitions.explanation: Taking care of oneself and solving one's own problems by one's own efforts, without depending on others. Common in disaster preparedness and social-policy language, often paired with {共助|きょうじょ} and {公助|こうじょ}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{備|そな}え→備え：11620_sonae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自助|じじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Disaster preparation starts with helping yourself.

examples.japanese: {自助|じじょ}・⟦{共助|きょうじょ}→共助：22215_kyoujo⟧・⟦{公助|こうじょ}→公助：32137_koujo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: We learn about self-help, mutual help, and public help.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大地震|おおじしん}→大地震：12276_oojishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{自助|じじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: Help does not arrive right after a big earthquake, so preparing to help yourself saves lives.

notes:
From {自|じ} (self) + {助|じょ} (help).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自助努力|じじょどりょく}: one's own efforts
- {自助|じじょ}⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧: self-help group, support group
- {自助|じじょ}・⟦{共助|きょうじょ}→共助：22215_kyoujo⟧・⟦{公助|こうじょ}→公助：32137_koujo⟧: self-help, mutual help, and public help

CULTURAL NOTE:
The three-part slogan {自助|じじょ}・⟦{共助|きょうじょ}→共助：22215_kyoujo⟧・⟦{公助|こうじょ}→公助：32137_koujo⟧ is standard in Japanese disaster planning: first protect yourself and your family, then help your neighbors, then rely on government aid.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{次女|じじょ}→次女：15831_jijo⟧ (second daughter) has the same reading.
